desktop_dial_wake_sent: Sent a wake signal to “{host}”. Waiting for it to come online…

desktop_console_ui_hint: Built for a TV and a controller
desktop_store_unsaved_body: Your changes aren’t being saved — Punktfunk can’t write to its settings folder.
desktop_hostcard_create_shortcut_hint: An app launcher entry that connects to this host
desktop_hostcard_copy_link_hint: A punktfunk:// link that connects to this host
desktop_shortcut_sandboxed_body: Punktfunk is sandboxed here, so it can't add the shortcut itself. Copy this link and make a launcher for it — it opens the same stream.
desktop_shortcut_added_body: Shortcut for “{name}” added to your applications
desktop_hostcard_share_clipboard_hint: Copy and paste between this device and that host
desktop_hostcard_speed_test_hint: Measures the link and recommends a bitrate
desktop_hostcard_pair_with_pin_hint: Enter the PIN the host shows to pair this device
desktop_hostcard_forget_identity_hint: Keeps the host saved; it has to be paired again to connect
desktop_hostcard_pair_by_click_hint: Click the card to pair it
desktop_hostcard_default_start_hosts_hin: Used when Start in opens the Library or a stream
desktop_hostcard_default_start_stream_hi: Punktfunk connects to it on launch
desktop_hostcard_wake_no_mac_hint: Add its MAC address under Connection to wake it
desktop_hostcard_no_presets_hint: Make one in Settings to connect with other settings.
desktop_hostcard_connect_with_hint: What a click on its card uses
desktop_speedtest_burst_body: The host sends a short burst to {host}
desktop_speedtest_measured_plane: Measured over the real data plane
desktop_lib_failed_pin: {host}'s certificate changed since you paired. Pair again to see its games.
desktop_lib_failed_not_paired: {host} doesn't recognize this device anymore. Pair again to see its games.
desktop_lib_failed_http: {host} turned the request down (HTTP {code}). Try again later.
desktop_lib_failed_unreachable: {host} didn't answer. Check that it's on, then try again.
desktop_lib_stale_unpaired: Last known library — pair again to refresh it
desktop_ring_editor_hint: Click a button to change it, or drag one onto another to swap the two.
desktop_ring_editor_open_hint: {keys}, a two-finger twist or {pad} opens quick actions in a stream.
desktop_ring_reset_body: Quick actions go back to this platform's default, and the shortcuts are removed.
desktop_ring_reset_tooltip: Restores the default quick actions and removes the shortcuts
desktop_ring_centre_tooltip: More — the rest of the actions, in the stream
desktop_shortcut_capture_tooltip: Then press the keys on your keyboard
desktop_controls_intro_body: Click the stream to capture your mouse and keyboard — the shortcuts below then work while you play. Release capture to hand the cursor back to this device, and click the stream again to retake it.
desktop_bitrate_kbps_hint: In Mbit/s, 0 lets the host decide — a host card's menu has a network speed test.
desktop_fullscreen_hint: Always keeps this window fullscreen too.
desktop_fullscreen_on_stream_exit_hint: {keys}, the mouse at the top edge, or {pad_keys} lead back out.
desktop_omarchy_menu_hint: {keys}: connect, wake, the controller interface — this writes rows to omarchy-menu.jsonc.
desktop_clear_art_hint: Posters are kept on this device so a library opens before the host answers.
desktop_player_overlay_actions_hint: Six buttons and the shortcuts they send, opened in a stream with {keys}, a two-finger twist or {pad_keys}.
desktop_pad_steam_virtual: Steam Input's virtual controller — Automatic skips it while a real one is connected
desktop_prefs_scope_editing_hint: Which layer these settings belong to
desktop_prefs_scope_hint: A preset overrides only what you change here; everything else follows Default settings.
desktop_preset_name_taken: Name — already used by another preset
desktop_prefs_not_saved_toast: Your changes aren’t being saved — Punktfunk can’t write to its settings folder.
desktop_about_system_libraries_body: This application dynamically links system libraries under their own licenses, including GTK 4 and libadwaita (LGPL v2.1+), PipeWire (MIT), and SDL 3 (Zlib). Their full license texts are available from each project. Video decoding uses the system's own Vulkan Video and VAAPI drivers (loaded at runtime, never linked), with OpenH264 and rav1d — both BSD-2-Clause, and both in the Rust crate notices — as the CPU fallback; no FFmpeg is linked or bundled.
desktop_prefs_not_saved_body: Punktfunk can’t write to its settings folder, so nothing on this page will survive a restart.
desktop_player_overlay_actions_preset_hi: A preset that changes quick actions sets all six buttons.
desktop_pad_detected_hint: Plug in or pair a controller and it appears here.
desktop_preset_sheet_hint: A preset overrides only what you change while it's selected; everything else follows Default settings.
desktop_about_logs_hint: The client log with the session's receive, decode and present trail — attach it to a bug report.
desktop_licenses_bundled_body: SDL 3 (Zlib) and the Windows App SDK (Microsoft) are linked; their notices ship in the installed licenses\\ folder. Video decoding uses Windows' own DXVA and Vulkan Video, with OpenH264 and rav1d (both BSD-2-Clause) as the CPU fallback — no FFmpeg is bundled.
desktop_notice_steam_touch_mouse: Steam Input is sending the touchscreen as a mouse — pick the Punktfunk controller layout for touch
desktop_stream_own_window: The stream has its own window — this one returns when the session ends.
desktop_stream_stats_off: The statistics overlay is off — {keys} in the stream window turns it on.
desktop_notice_amd_hdr_driver: This AMD graphics driver ({version}) can show HDR as a green picture. Update it to AMD Software 25.9.1 or newer, or switch the decoder to Direct3D 11 in Settings.
desktop_hosts_field_mac_hint: Wakes this host from sleep. Found on the network automatically when it's on; separate several with commas.
